criterion: Pinpoints the defect in finsplit/allocator.py (allocate_shares) where integer cents are converted to binary float and rounded independently per share via round(), losing remainder cents instead of distributing largest-remainder integer cents.

Pinpoints the second defect in finsplit/reconciler.py (Reconciler.verify_invoice) where invoice-level discount is computed on the aggregate subtotal while allocate_shares applies and rounds the discount on each individual share prior to summation.
Explains how per-share discount rounding and unallocated remainder cents compound so sum(allocated_cents) diverges from net_invoice_cents even when weights sum to 100%.
References finsplit/allocator.py (CostShare, allocate_shares) and finsplit/reconciler.py (InvoiceSummary, Reconciler.verify_invoice).
Describes the fix: computing discounts once on the invoice total (or allocating post-discount net integer cents) and distributing integer remainder cents deterministically across shares.
